opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search sorted by price
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue flights for a given origin, destination, trip type and dates, then sort results by price low to high and apply.
steps: Type origin in From and pick the suggestion
Type destination in To and pick the suggestion
Select Roundtrip or One-way
Pick depart (and return) dates in the calendar
Click Search flights and Continue to flight results
Open Sort & Filter, choose Default dropdown, select Price (low to high), click Apply

instances.values: New York -> Miami, roundtrip 27th-31st, sort Price by Core, Points
New York -> Toronto, one-way 29th, Price low to high
New York -> Aruba, return May 5 2023, Price low to high

opportunities.name: Budget Careers job search by filters
opportunities.description: On Budget careers openings, filter by country, team and time type, then run the search.
steps: Click Careers then Openings
Open Country, search and select the country
Open Team, search and select the team
Open Time Type, search and select the type
Click SEARCH BY JOB TITLE OR KEYWORD
Optionally open a job and click APPLY NOW

instances.values: USA, Finance, Full time, opened Accounts Payable Associate and Apply

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search car rentals on United by pickup location, dates and times.
steps: Click CAR tab
Type pickup location and choose suggestion
Click Pickup field and choose pickup and drop-off dates
Optionally set pickup and drop-off times
Click Find cars

opportunities.name: Retail product search with max price and add to cart
opportunities.description: Search a retailer for a product, set a max price, and add a result to cart.
steps: Type product keyword in search box and submit
Enter maximum price and click Go
Open a result
Click Add to Cart

opportunities.name: NPS find a park by activity or topic
opportunities.description: Use NPS Find a Park search by activity or topic and select filter options.
steps: Click FIND A PARK
Click Search by Activity or Topic
Choose Activity or Topic tab
Tick desired option(s)
Click Search

opportunities.name: MTA bridges and tunnels toll lookup

steps: Open Fares & Tolls / Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels
Open toll rates
Select vehicle type
